attempts.summary: Implemented Ansible-based synchronization of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2, orchestrated from node3 (the only node with Ansible installed, hence the control node). Enabled sshd/generated host keys on node1 and node2, authorized node3's SSH key for root, created a source-of-truth app.conf on node1, and deployed an Ansible inventory + playbook on node3 that fetches from node1 and copies to node2. A cron job on node3 runs this every 5 minutes, well inside the 15-minute requirement. Verified propagation of multiple content changes automatically via the scheduled job. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id/service state, restarted each node one at a time with native reboot, confirmed boot_id changes, and confirmed recovery of services/data (ssh on node1/node2; cron+ansible tooling on node3). After node3's own restart, verified the sync pipeline still worked end-to-end by pushing a further change on node1 and confirming automatic cron-driven propagation to node2.
